title: Breast Cancer Surgery 10-Year Survival Prediction by Machine Learning: A Large Prospective Cohort Study
summary: The study compares model performance using separate test and validation sets in a large prospective cohort registry. Despite the prospective cohort source, this is a retrospective model analysis; external prospective benefit is not established.
ai_technology: Retrospective multi-center registry data are used to compare DNN, KNN, SVM, naive Bayes and Cox models for 10-year breast-cancer survival.
